question.problem: Calculate the diameter of a sphere given that its volume is $972\pi \,{\text{m}}^{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
We can find the volume of a sphere using the formula

$$
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi \cdot {r}^{3},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $V=972\pi \,{\text{m}}^{3}$ into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =\frac{4}{3}\pi {r}^{3} \\ 972\pi  & =\frac{4}{3}\pi {r}^{3} \\ 972\pi \cdot \frac{3}{4\pi } & ={r}^{3} \\ {r}^{3} & =729.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
r=\sqrt[3]{729}=9\,\text{m}.
$$

Finally, the diameter of the sphere is

$$
d=2r=2\cdot 9=18\,\text{m}.
$$
